purpose.zh: 不加重量，练髋部向外转的控制
purpose.en: Train control of turning your hip outward, with no added weight.

text.zh: 大腿和膝盖不动，脚慢慢向内摆
text.en: Keep your thigh and knee still and swing your foot slowly inward

text.zh: 坐在椅子上，这只脚稍微离地，另一只脚踩稳。
text.en: Sit with this foot just off the floor and the other foot planted.

text.zh: 小幅度慢慢摆，上身和骨盆不转。
text.en: Move through a small range slowly, keeping your hips and body facing forward.

cautions.zh: 膝盖或髋部疼时幅度小一点，还疼就停
cautions.en: If your knee or hip hurts, move less far, and stop if it still hurts.

changes: 改名「坐椅无阻力髋外旋控制」→「坐椅小腿向内摆」（外旋是术语）；EN 名同步
节奏按 spec 时间轴手算（派生值把 90% 以上都算停顿，和 spec 不符）：摆 1.7/停 3.0/回 2.1/歇 1.2 s
flags: 改名：坐椅无阻力髋外旋控制 / Seated Active Hip External Rotation → 坐椅小腿向内摆 / Seated Inward Shin Swing
